name: Absorb Identity — Shapeshifters you control become copies of the targeted creature
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "You may have Shapeshifters you control become copies of that creature until end of turn." parsed to nothing: the copy parser only read "a copy of". A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Woodland Changeling (a Shapeshifter) becomes Hill Giant; Grizzly Bears is no Shapeshifter and stays.
